title: Settlement Agreements Consumer Action Card: Accepting a Three-Payment Settlement on a Recorded Call
content:
# Three-Payment Settlement — Acceptance on a Recorded Call

## The rule's subject

This rule fixes the Three-Payment call acceptance window, the number of calendar days from the acceptance date to the due date of the first settlement payment, when a consumer accepts a Three-Payment Settlement offer on a recorded call, which the Three-Payment Settlement allows; acceptance by electronic signature or in the portal, and acceptance of any other programme, is outside this rule. The Three-Payment Settlement is a programme of Ridgeline's Settlement Agreements.

## What the acceptance waits on

A recorded-call acceptance of a Three-Payment Settlement is not booked until the account carries an open Three-Payment offer dated within its validity.

In the same terms: where the account shows no Three-Payment Settlement offer still in status offered and within its validity on the handling date, no recorded-call acceptance of a Three-Payment Settlement is booked on it.

## What the consumer's action does

`accept_settlement_offer_on_recorded_call_60e9ef1d` is the consumer's acceptance, on the recorded call, of an open written settlement offer on one of their placed accounts. One call moves that settlement from offered to accepted with today as the acceptance date and a recorded call as the acceptance method, sets the first settlement payment due the given number of calendar days after today and the final payment due the offer's payment interval after it for each remaining payment, sets the amount still to pay under the settlement to the offer's settlement amount, and books that settlement amount to the settlement once as today's scheduled amount. The consumer can see the settlement as accepted with its new due dates.

## How it is invoked

This is the consumer's own tool: the agent unlocks `accept_settlement_offer_on_recorded_call_60e9ef1d` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `settlement_id` | the settlement reference number of the open offer being accepted, as returned by the settlement lookup | identifier |
| `first_payment_due_in_days` | the number of calendar days after today on which settlement payment 1 falls due | whole integer of at least 1 |

## Return

A text rendering of a dictionary with: `settlement_id`; `status` (always "accepted" on success); `accepted_date` (YYYY-MM-DD, today); `acceptance_method` (`recorded_call`); `first_payment_due_date` and `final_payment_due_date` (YYYY-MM-DD); `amount_scheduled` (USD, 2 decimals, the settlement amount booked today); `schedule_entry_id` (reference of the booked scheduled-amount entry). A returned status of accepted means the acceptance is on record.

## Hypothetical receipt

Run with a hypothetical settlement reference and a value of 12 for `first_payment_due_in_days`, the receipt shows status accepted, method `recorded_call`, an acceptance date of today and a first payment due date 12 calendar days after today.
